newsitem.title: GREECE: Athens bourse clears Edrasi bond issue.
newsitem.headline: Athens bourse clears Edrasi bond issue.

text.p: The Athens stock exchange cleared the 2,195 million drachma convertible bond issue of Greek construction firm Edrasi-Psallidas, it said in a statement.
Edrasi will issue 1,045,200 bearer bonds, entitling existing shareholders to 20 bonds per 100 shares at 2,100 drachmas each.
The bonds may be converted into common registered shares with voting rights at a price of 2,600 drachmas over a three-year period, it said.
Proceeds will be used to retire short-term debt and finance capital investments.
Edrasi's shares closed down 60 drachmas at 1,910 on Thursday on volume of 3,000 shares. --Angelos Kiosklis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
